s1.desc: a bedroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a yellow bed with duck-topped bedposts and a nightstand with a peach lamp

beats.text: Polly waddles up to the bed where Pax lies asleep under the blanket with his beak open
Polly gently shakes Pax by the shoulder while he stirs and squints one eye open
Polly turns from the bed to face forward with a sweet smile while Pax groggily pokes a flipper out over the blanket

spans.notes: Polly is cut by the left edge for the first few frames. Bed edges overlap exactly in compare 0/40. A pan starts at f47. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_5): Beat 36-47 says Polly 'waddles off': she keeps shaking Pax until f39, then at f40-46 only turns on the spot to face forward (eyes closed in a smile f40-42, open f43+); her feet stay put. She only starts walking in the pan after f47.
Pan (left and down) following Polly from the bed to the vanity; lamp edge moves from f47, settles at f82 (f82 = f83 = f84).

spans.view: with a low white vanity table holding a purple handbag and a phone, and a nightstand with a peach lamp behind

beats.text: Polly stands at the low vanity table, glancing over the things laid out on it
Polly picks up a red hairbrush from the table
Polly brushes the top of her head with the red hairbrush, her eyes wide open
Polly lowers the hairbrush in front of her face and shuts her eyes

spans.notes: The handbag carries a tiny penguin keychain charm (about 3% of frame height) - kept as a prop, see report. Phone lies face up on the table, untouched here. Static: compare 82/127. A quick pull-back starts at f128. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_5): Beat 94-128 says she brushes 'smiling': her face is neutral and wide-eyed while brushing (crops f110), and at f125-127 she lowers the brush in front of her face and shuts her eyes. The brush is picked up at f91-93, not before.; Handbag charm (f82, f300 full-res crop): a dark-headed penguin figurine with a blue bow and a rose sweater, neither Pax nor Polly, so it stays a prop as the curator decided
Quick pull-back from the vanity to the wide two-shot (v4 and the profile read it as a dissolve; the strip shows a continuous scale change). Static again from f133.

spans.view: with a low white vanity table in the foreground and a yellow bed, a nightstand and a peach lamp behind

beats.text: Pax opens one eye in bed and lifts his head from the pillow while Polly holds the red hairbrush up to her face at the vanity
Pax slowly props himself up on one flipper and peels back the blanket while Polly stands at the vanity with the brush

spans.notes: Static: compare 133/178 (vanity, nightstand, bed edges black).

spans.view: with a low white vanity table holding a purple handbag and a phone, and a nightstand with a peach lamp behind

beats.text: Polly holds the red hairbrush up in front of her face, glancing off to the side
Polly reaches over to her purple handbag and drops the hairbrush into it
Polly rests a flipper on the closed handbag and looks down at it
Polly blinks and lifts her gaze to look straight ahead

spans.notes: Same framing as [82,128). Static: left-strip bbox constant (table leg x=25, floor y=760). A quick pull-back starts at f222. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_5): Beat 210-222 says Polly 'stares ahead blankly': from f210 to f217 she looks down at the handbag with her flipper on it, blinks at f219, and only looks ahead at f221. She also reaches a flipper to the bag from f195, before the brush goes in at f203-207.
Quick pull-back to the wide two-shot, static again from f226.

spans.view: with a low white vanity table in the foreground and a yellow bed, a nightstand and a peach lamp behind

beats.text: Pax opens one eye in bed and lifts his head from the pillow while Polly stares over at him from the vanity
Polly raises a flipper toward Pax with an annoyed look while he props himself up and peels back the blanket

spans.notes: Pax repeats the same wake-up animation as [133,179) (the skit's loop gag).

spans.view: with a low white vanity table and a nightstand with a peach lamp behind

beats.text: Polly stands at the vanity with a flipper on her hip and an annoyed frown
Polly picks up {ifin} from the table and drops it into her purple handbag
Polly lifts the handbag off the table and clutches it to her front, frowning

spans.notes: Phone: grey case, black screen, little tuft at the top end, lenses on the back as she lifts it (f283) = iFin. Static: left-strip bbox constant (table leg x=25, floor y=760).

spans.view: with a yellow bed with duck-topped bedposts and a nightstand with a peach lamp

beats.text: Polly waddles to the bedside clutching her handbag and grabs Pax's flipper as he sits up groggily
Polly marches forward to the right, pulling a sleepy Pax out of bed behind her by the flipper

spans.notes: Camera locked (compare 310/336: bed, lamp, nightstand edges black); keep12 is low because both leads move a lot. Polly walks down-screen toward the viewer and grows slightly, hence size_change. Polly is cut by the left edge at f310-312.
